label: def:stable-atom
title: Stable atom (ILP feasibility)
html:
Definition. Let K be an atom-knot (atom) with normal form T_w \in H_{n(K)}(q). Let \mathrm{G}(q) be the Frobenius Gram matrix of the primitive Wedderburn-block operators \{e_\lambda\}_{\lambda \vdash k,\;k \leq k_{\max}} (mass-coefficient-shadow-price). Decompose the normal form in the primitive basis:

  T_w
  \;=\;
  \sum_\lambda x_\lambda \cdot e_\lambda,
  \qquad
  x_\lambda \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}.

The atom K is stable at q if and only if this decomposition admits an ILP (integer linear program) solution:

  \exists\, x \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}^N
  \;\text{such that}\;
  \mathrm{G}(q) \, x \;\geq\; 0
  \;\text{coordinatewise.}

That is, the Frobenius positivity constraint (Gx)_\gamma \geq 0 holds for every primitive constraint \gamma with x a nonnegative integer vector.
